description: A PHYSICAL LINK REQUEST with the LINK bit set is answered PHYSICAL LINK REJECTED with reason 5, exclusive links not supported, and no link is made.
note: At 2000, from 0.0.1.3 (EOT 10, end 7000), a PHYSICAL LINK REQUEST with LINK and Ed4 set (octet 13). HARD LINKS are not supported, so the answer is PHYSICAL LINK REJECTED, reason 5 (octet 35) (B-0128, B-0148, B-0313). Burst end 3000: csma.vdcd_end 4000; at 7000 rule 1, slot 15, 45000 ms; at 52000 the reject goes out. No link_state output: no link was made or is being made. Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so one type 8 D_PDU carrying a one-byte C_PDU (address size 3, C-0133) fills a block exactly and a one-block transmission lasts 5550 ms, EOT and reception window ceil(4950 / 500) = 10 (C-0104, C-1043, C-0350). Every C_PDU of this scenario is a one-octet CAS-1 C_PDU sent once in a type 8 D_PDU (B-0129, B-0143, B-0152, B-0191), C_PDU IDs from 0 (C-1040), EOW 0. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15 then 4: contention waits 45000 then 12000 ms (K-0080). Settings: cas.max_links, cas.link_request_timeout_ms 60000, cas.link_request_retries and cas.first_data_timeout_ms 120000.
